$comment: Per-series harvest lists for the Harvest tab. Checkbox state lives in the per-dinner Firestore doc (state.harvest). Built 2026-07-29 off the 7/24 Kelly call + the August sourcing table. Farm morning-picks: summer squash, sweet peppers, cucumbers, cabbage, tender herbs, edible flowers, squash blossoms, farm berries. Onions for the agrodolce come down to SF ahead (one cook for the whole series). Corn, blackberries and huckleberries are bought-in. Tomatoes are UPSIDE ONLY — the Course 1 plate is complete without them, do not force them.

weekends.label: August 8-9
weekends.intro: Only what needs picking fresh at the farm this weekend. Corn and blackberries are bought-in and arrive with the load. The agrodolce onions already came down to SF. Lamb and crab are both handled at the farm — see the confirm list. Sunday repeats Saturday.

items.name: Summer squash
items.note: Course 1 both ways — raw ribbons + charred scapece · pick young and firm, nothing seedy · the panelle squash already went into the trays at SF

items.name: Sweet peppers
items.note: Course 1 · charred on the Egg then marinated — replaced the beans, Kelly has these in volume

items.name: Cucumbers
items.note: Crab bite vessel · sliced into rounds, pick + chill early, they hold better cold

items.name: Cabbage
items.note: Course 3 contorni · cut into wedges, grilled, finished in the lamb jus · Kelly holding 50 lb, claim 30-40 for the series

items.name: Tender herbs (oregano, mint, basil)
items.note: oregano → salmoriglio · mint → scapece, the crab bite, the dessert · basil → the risotto, pick last and keep it out of the cold

items.name: Edible flowers
items.note: garnish — Course 1 and the dessert scatter · nasturtium, calendula, borage all at peak

items.name: Squash blossoms
items.qty: garnish scale, whatever the morning gives
items.note: torn over Course 1 · nice to have, the plate is finished without them

items.name: Loganberries (+ red currants if holding)
items.note: Course 4 · farm berries lead the maceration, bought-in blackberries are the volume layer underneath

items.name: Heirloom tomatoes — UPSIDE ONLY
items.qty: only if they have colored up
items.note: Course 1 · marinated, fills in around the edges. Do NOT force it — the plate is complete without them and there is no hedge order.

confirm.name: Lamb (at the farm)
confirm.note: Legs + shoulders for the weekend, defrosted and allocated. CUTS AND METHOD STILL IN TEST — confirm the final spec with Sam before Thursday of prep week.

confirm.name: Dungeness crab (at the farm)
confirm.note: 3-4 crabs per night. Tim cooks and picks on site Thu/Fri; picked meat goes to the bite, shells get roasted into the risotto brodo. No prior-weekend freeze needed unless the catch runs long.

confirm.name: Onions — already sent to SF
confirm.note: Farm onions, agrodolce cooked in one batch at SF for the whole series. Confirm the count went down; nothing to pick this weekend.

weekends.footnote: Coming down from the restaurant, do NOT pick fresh: the set panelle trays, the par-cooked rice, the braise and its jus, the olive oil cakes, ricotta salata, mascarpone, honey, chickpea flour, and the agrodolce. Bought-in and arriving with the load: sweet corn, blackberries. No bread this series — there is no Breadfarm order.

items.name: Sweet peppers
items.note: Course 1 · charred then marinated · riper peppers this week, expect more sweetness and less time on the fire
